HPPSC HPAS Online Form 2026 – Last Date – Full Details

Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) has released a Notification for the HP Administrative Services, Block Development Officer, Tehsildar and Assistant Commissioner Post. This recruitment has released for 22 posts. The applications for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026 has Started from 26 August 2026, and candidate can apply till 22 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 August 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result Available : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS : Rs.600/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 600/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
